title: 第3章 初识系统第4章 接管家族
content_zh:
第一卷 第3章 初识系统
林天回到现实当中，扫视了一下周围的，35个健康的长枪兵仍然忠实的护卫在周围，而剩下的19个重伤员流血不止，七七八八的躺在地上呻吟。林天有些束手无策了，难道就这么让他们死去吗？某宅有点心疼，无论是心疼这些士兵还是心疼金币，毕竟这都是活生生有血有肉的人，不会被系统象游戏里一样直接刷成白光。而且也是效忠于自己的力量嘛，得想办法救活他们！
挑了个感觉上最机灵的长枪兵，拉过来套套话。
“重伤的士兵，自己会自动痊愈吗？或者说怎么才能给伤员进行治疗？”
这位枪兵同志如同有智慧的人一样，表现的很激动，有点领导视察来校视察，某挫人被接见时那种受宠若惊的感觉，慌忙回答道：“我们神赐战士，受伤后只要进入英雄空间休息1天，就可依靠系统的神力滋养，伤势会自动痊愈。”
“英雄如果学习了治疗术也可以在战斗中治疗，另外牧师或僧侣等拥有特殊能力的兵种，可以用特殊能力进行治疗，不过效果和次数都不能跟英雄相比！”
经过几个简单的问题发现，1阶的长枪兵只具备初级智慧，知道的也并不多，太复杂的东西也不会，相信后面的高级兵种能更聪明一点，知道的更多一些。林天将19名重伤员收入英雄空间，晾它一天，明天招出来看看。
环顾一下周围战场，轻轻的吹来一阵凉风，还未等他好好享受一下这磬心的凉爽，就被后面夹杂的浓烈血腥味给熏到了，接着就是一阵恶心的干呕，之前为了活命还没太在意，但现在彻底安静下来就被恶心到了，毕竟只是个宅男而已，还是太矫情了。
大吐了一阵，感觉好些点，某宅赶紧离这片修罗场远点。吩咐长枪兵们把战场打扫一下，把尸体拖到村外集中起来火化掉。领主夫妇的尸体单独火化并立上木碑，林天亲自在上面写上了悼词，毕竟占据了人家儿子的身体，能做得到的就尽量做吧。另外从领主身上取下了1个造型奇特的勋章，图案的是剑与狮鹫的形状，从哈肯记忆中，这个是家族徽记，贵族荣誉的象征，佩带在胸前可以做为信物，以后继承领主男爵的爵位，接收家产，就全靠它了。
死宅男左右看看无事，决定动身返回仙林城。早些接收家族的权利和财产，以防日久生变。安排长枪兵在前面护卫开路，从英雄空间中召唤出+10%行动速度的新手战马，保持与枪兵等同的匀速，晃晃悠悠的启程回家。一路上也没有再受到其他的干扰，某宅记起好象之前升级时开启了精灵族主城，还没建造今天的建筑呢。之前因为生命危在旦夕，不可能详细欣赏，现在总算闲下来了，于是他就将心神再次沉入了系统中，准备仔细参观了一番。
进入人族主城，城墙是自动修建好的，已经类似于游戏里的顶级城墙状态了，非常的雄伟厚重，这说明系统是不需要自己额外花资源建造城墙这种防御建筑了。整个一大圈厚厚的城墙，围起了一大片空旷的地盘，现在是新城建筑几乎没有，里头孤零零的就只有一座哥特式的小型城堡，之前他就是在这里招募长枪兵的，应该是跟游戏里一样，可以更快的招募全族兵种。另外在外围还有一座长枪兵营，这可是自己花1000金币建造的。说起金币，就不得不提在游戏里跟金币一样重要的各类资源，貌似在目前的系统里，再也找不着游戏里的石头、木材、宝石、水晶、硫磺、水银等资源了，这块明显被偷懒的系统给简化了，一切资源只有金币才通用。
某宅眼珠一转，退出了系统，然后手里拿着一枚金币，在晃悠悠的马上渗人的傻笑……系统中的金币和现实中的金币，居然可以完全通用，1比1可以随地随时转换，这无疑是个天大的福音哪。
进入精灵族主城，同样是被一圈荆棘城墙围住，瞧这厚度，不用看也到顶了。中心位置是一颗巨大的生命古树，如同魔兽世界里的世界之树一般，雄伟巨大，树冠厚重的树叶差不多遮蔽了整个主城，目前没有任何其他建筑。
林天想了想，选择建造1阶花妖丛林－1000，招募了60个花妖－60*10，剩余7200金。
花妖丛林其实就是一些长满浆果的灌木丛，而招募的花妖就有点非主流了，1米4左右的娇小身躯，被简易加工过的树藤缠住3点重要部位，头上带着花和青草，雪白柔嫩的肌肤上，有小面积的纹身，赤着脚不带任何武器。虽然看起来很漂亮，象娇小可爱的萝莉妹子，但是请允许本宅说声，让所有的平板娘退散吧……就这平板身材，实在看不出有啥战斗力来，能跟威武的长枪兵比吗？
死宅甲带着怀疑的眼神，查看花妖的详细资料，攻击力低下，防御力全无，特点是飞行兵种，行动速度快，能挥洒微毒的花粉同时攻击周围多个目标.特性是养蜂，共栖（未激活）。
养蜂：每天可以使用1次召唤蜂群滋扰，有机会打断释法。
还有个升级后兵种林妖的特技共栖（未激活）：能与6阶树妖发动共栖特效，可以恢复两者少量的生命和魔法。特性相当犀利啊！强大的不是她本身，而是她能使6阶兵种更强大。可以想象几百林妖与大肉盾树妖发动共栖技能时，怎么都打不死的场景吗？那岂不是萝莉无敌了？
林天心情一片大好！另外花妖应该是英雄无敌5里的生物，那英雄无敌3中的半人马怎么看不见？难道被划归到兽人族去了，毕竟英雄无敌5的兽族是有半人马射手这个兵种的。看来系统还是做了相当程度的融合和微调。本来还想趁现在有空多研究研究，但奈何系统信息把控的很严，达不到建造条件的一律都看不见。
英雄骑士林天，攻击3防御3法力1知识2。

天赋优势大师，能力为初级智慧术，初级幸运术，初级进攻术，初级后勤术。
装备+1攻击的新手剑，+1防御的新手铠，+1法力的新手手套，+1知识的新手头盔，+10%行动速度的新手鞋，+10%火焰抗性的火焰披风，+10%行动速度的新手坐骑战马，+1幸运四叶草。战争机械无.
副职业2级火魔法新手,hp80+60+20=160,mp80+30+20=130，魔法0级冥想，1级小火球，2级火盾。
人族主城，1阶长枪兵营。精灵主城，1阶花妖丛林.
1阶长枪兵54名，1阶花妖60名.
金库剩余金币7200金。
哎，还是回家洗洗睡吧！
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 3 First introduction to the system
Lin Tian returned to reality and glanced around. 35 healthy pikemen were still loyally guarding the surroundings, while the remaining 19 seriously injured people were bleeding and lying on the ground groaning. Lin Tian was a little helpless. Should he just let them die like this? A certain house felt a little distressed, whether it was for these soldiers or for the gold coins. After all, these were living flesh-and-blood people, and they would not be directly painted white by the system like in the game. And they are loyal to their own power, so they have to find a way to save them!
He picked the spearman who seemed the smartest and pulled him over to talk to him.
"Will seriously injured soldiers recover automatically? Or how can we treat the wounded?"
Like a wise man, the comrade Lancer acted very excited. He felt a bit flattered when a leader came to inspect the school. He hurriedly replied: "We God-given warriors, after being injured, we only need to enter the hero space to rest for one day, and we can rely on the divine power of the system to nourish us, and the injury will heal automatically."
"Heroes can also heal in battle if they learn healing techniques. In addition, priests or monks and other soldiers with special abilities can use special abilities to heal, but the effect and frequency cannot be compared with heroes!"
After a few simple questions, I found that the first-level spearmen only have rudimentary intelligence and don't know much, and they don't know anything too complicated. I believe that the advanced soldiers behind will be smarter and know more. Lin Tian put the 19 seriously injured people into the hero space, let them dry for a day, and then recruit them out tomorrow.
Looking around the battlefield, a cool breeze blew gently. Before he could fully enjoy the coolness of the chime, he was overtaken by the strong smell of blood mixed with it, followed by a nauseating retching. Before, he didn't care too much in order to survive, but now that he was completely quiet, he was disgusted. After all, he was just an otaku, and it was still too pretentious.
After vomiting for a while and feeling better, a certain house quickly stayed away from this Shura field. He ordered the pikemen to clean up the battlefield, drag the bodies to the outside of the village, gather them and cremate them. The bodies of the lord and his wife were cremated separately and erected on a wooden monument. Lin Tian personally wrote a eulogy on it. After all, he occupied the body of his son, so he should do what he could. In addition, a strange-looking medal was removed from the lord. The pattern was in the shape of a sword and a griffon. From Haken's memory, this was the family emblem, a symbol of noble honor. It could be worn on the chest as a token. In the future, inheriting the lord's baron title and receiving the family property would all depend on it.
The dead otaku looked around to see if nothing happened, and decided to leave to return to Xianlin City. Take over family rights and property early to prevent changes over time. Arrange the pikemen to guard the way in front, summon a novice war horse with +10% movement speed from the hero space, maintain the same speed as the pikemen, and set off home staggeringly. There was no other interference along the way. A certain house remembered that the main city of the elves had been opened during the previous upgrade, and today's building had not been built yet. Because his life was at stake, it was impossible to appreciate it in detail before. Now that he was finally free, he immersed his mind in the system again and prepared to take a closer look.
Entering the main city of the human race, the city wall is automatically built. It is already similar to the top city wall in the game. It is very majestic and thick. This shows that the system does not need to spend additional resources to build defensive buildings such as city walls. The entire thick city wall encloses a large area of ​​open land. There are almost no buildings in the new city now, and there is only a small Gothic-style castle inside. He used to recruit pikemen here. It should be the same as in the game, and he can recruit all types of troops faster. In addition, there is a pike barracks outside, which costs 1,000 gold.Built with coins. Speaking of gold coins, we have to mention various resources that are as important as gold coins in the game. It seems that in the current system, you can no longer find resources such as stone, wood, gems, crystals, sulfur, mercury, etc. in the game. This area has been simplified by the lazy system. All resources are only common to gold coins.
A certain house rolled his eyes and exited the system. He then held a gold coin in his hand and gave a silly smile as he swayed on his horse... The gold coins in the system and the gold coins in reality can be completely interchangeable. They can be converted 1:1 at any time and anywhere. This is undoubtedly a great blessing.
Entering the main city of the elves, you are also surrounded by a wall of thorns. Look at how thick it is. You can reach the top without even looking. In the center is a huge ancient tree of life, just like the World Tree in World of Warcraft. It is majestic and huge. The thick leaves of the tree crown almost cover the entire main city. There are currently no other buildings.
Lin Tian thought about it and chose to build a level 1 flower demon jungle - 1000. He recruited 60 flower demons - 60*10 and had 7200 gold left.
The flower demon jungle is actually some bushes full of berries, and the flower demons recruited are a bit unconventional. They have a petite body of about 1.4 meters, with three important parts entangled by simply processed tree vines. They have flowers and grass on their heads. There are small tattoos on their snow-white and tender skin, and they are barefoot without any weapons. Although she looks very beautiful, like a petite and cute loli girl, please allow me to say something and let all the flat girls retreat... With this flat figure, I really don't see any fighting ability. Can it compare with the mighty spearmen?
With a suspicious look in his eyes, Death Man A looked at the flower demon's detailed information. He found that his attack power was low and his defense was completely lacking. He was characterized as a flying unit, with fast movement speed and the ability to spread slightly poisonous pollen to attack multiple targets around him at the same time. His characteristics were beekeeping and symbiosis (not activated).
Beekeeping: You can use it once a day to summon a swarm of bees to cause nuisance, and there is a chance to interrupt the spell.
There is also an upgraded unit, the wood demon's special skill of symbiosis (not activated): it can activate the symbiosis special effect with the level 6 tree demon, which can restore a small amount of life and magic of both. The characteristics are quite sharp! What is powerful is not herself, but the fact that she can make the 6th level troops more powerful. Can you imagine a scene in which hundreds of forest demons and large human shield tree demons activate their symbiosis skills, but they can't be killed no matter what? Wouldn’t that mean Loli is invincible?
Lin Tian was in a good mood! In addition, the Flower Demon should be a creature in Heroes 5, so why can’t the centaur be seen in Heroes 3? Could it be that they are classified as Orcs? After all, the Orcs in Heroes of Might and Magic 5 have Centaur Archer as a unit. It seems that the system has still undergone a considerable degree of integration and fine-tuning. I originally wanted to take advantage of my free time to do more research, but the system information is very strictly controlled, and anything that does not meet the construction conditions will not be seen.
Hero Knight Lin Tian, ​​attack 3 defense 3 mana 1 knowledge 2.
A master of talent advantage, his abilities are primary wisdom, primary luck, primary offense, and primary logistics.
Equip a novice sword with +1 attack, novice armor with +1 defense, novice gloves with +1 mana, a novice helmet with +1 knowledge, novice shoes with +10% movement speed, a flame cloak with +10% fire resistance, a novice mount war horse with +10% movement speed, and a lucky four-leaf clover. War Machine None.
A novice with level 2 fire magic as a sub-professional, hp80+60+20=160, mp80+30+20=130, magic level 0 meditation, level 1 small fireball, and level 2 fire shield.
The main city of the human race, level 1 pike barracks. The main elf city, level 1 flower demon jungle.
There are 54 level 1 spearmen and 60 level 1 flower demons.
There are 7200 gold coins left in the vault.
Hey, let’s go home and wash up and sleep!
